name: Bottiglieria 1881

menus.name: Full experience tasting menu
menus.note: Wine pairings at PLN 540, 750 or 1,300, or the sommelier's selection at PLN 3,000; non-alcoholic pairing PLN 350. The whole table orders the same menu.

menus.name: Introduction tasting menu
menus.note: A slightly shorter menu. Wine pairings at PLN 490, 700 or 1,150, or PLN 2,500; non-alcoholic pairing PLN 270–300.

bookingOpens: Online through DinnerBooking, linked from the restaurant's website, or by phone or email (biuro@1881.com.pl). Booking means ordering a tasting menu; there is no à la carte.
cancellation: An email 48 hours before the booking asks guests to reconfirm by clicking its link; unconfirmed tables are not guaranteed and may be cancelled. Tables are held for 15 minutes after the booking time.
children: Children aged 12 and over are welcome. There is no children's menu, and no high chairs or booster seats.
